notes.title: Update to ver 1.4
notes.notes:
- Fixed the problem that the next ball rarely ceases to exist after the ball falls.
· UI fonts have been completely redesigned.
- I made it fade out BGM at game over.
· I changed the engine around the flipper to the engine that was scheduled for the next work.
· We changed the processing of 1 way gate.
· Changed knocker S.E.
· I was worried very much, I changed S.E. of Next Double.
· Balls were added to ADD 6 BUMPER, COLLECT PARLOR, COLLECT KICKBACK, and processing was changed when the ball immediately entered.

There is a possibility that the flipper may not work on the keyboard in some environments, and it is under scrutiny now.

The score of Jackassforce of 1st place has an offer of the person himself, and we canceled the registration by our company acceptance.

notes.title: Update to v1.3
notes.notes:
1. Fix a problem that AGAIN status won't reset.
2. Fix a but that occasionally a light will not turn off and causes a confusion at the top bumper.
3. Increased tilt warning from 3 to 5 at start.
4. After the year 2000 is lit, PARLOR feature will not be achieved at center target.

notes.title: Update to ver 1.2
notes.notes:
1. Added Light Weight(DX9) version which is even less demanding on PC's performance.

 2. Fix a bug that causes two balls to come out in plunger lane simultaneously.

 3. Adjusted collision detection.

 4. Fix a bug on kick back that causes kick back to kick twice even when it is not Next Double.

 5. Fix a bug that causes the gameplay to stop when a ball goes down a drain after a pause.

 6. Removed an effect to turn off the light on GAMEOVER.

 7. Added some sound effects.
